title: iPhone Duo: A definitive foldable that aces its debut
summary: Apple’s first foldable smartphone is a polished, refined device that reimagines iPhone in a foldable form factor. It will certainly make people rethink how they use their smartphones as this unit is not a regular slab phone but a mini-tablet that can be folded and easily carried around in your pocket
llm_summary: Apple’s inaugural foldable, the iPhone Duo, blends the classic iPhone experience with a mini‑tablet’s larger screen, folding neatly enough to slip into a pocket. Its sleek design and refined execution promise to reshape how users think about and interact with their smartphones.
